incidents.name: unverified_0000
incidents.notes: Missing access control on drain selector 0x88417d5c lets any caller transfer the victim contract's ERC20 balances to itself.

sources.ref: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the unverified victim sets no EIP-1967 implementation or beacon slot and its runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 49557639 and the incident block 50311056; its single DELEGATECALL (pc 0x03c7) forwards the full calldata to an address taken from the stack after a loop comparing CALLER against a whitelist, i.e. a per-call target supplied by the caller rather than an installed implementation read from storage, so nothing about the victim's own code changed after deployment.
